name: kipwell-stays
description: Kipwell Stays: hotel and guesthouse marketplace

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.js && esbuild src/client/main.tsx --bundle --minify --target=es2022 --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --external:/fonts/* --outfile=dist/public/app.js && cp -r public/. dist/public/
